user_saw: A workspace file appeared in the browser tree but was missing from search results when the query used a different Unicode representation of the same name.
summary: The Gateway now normalizes the query and candidate paths to NFC for workspace file search and returns the original paths.
reasoning: The July 1 checkout snapshot already used lowercase substring matching in sessions.files.list, which misses canonically equivalent filenames in different Unicode forms. The September extraction into workspace-files.ts and the later refactors preserved that comparison. Offline history stops at the shallow boundary, so I could not verify whether the first implementation shipped with this defect or an older change introduced it.
